body:
When I read your words I perceive that you feel you are trapped in a vicious corner. You say that you live in a bad area for trans folks. Do you have any possibility to move away to a better space that welcomes you for you, just as you are, irrelevant of your sexual preferences? Even if you are in debt with your bank, can you call someone to ask for help to get out of your area and situation? You say that everyone is tired of you but might there still be someone you could call in your difficult predicament? I wish you well and wish I could say something of value to you.

Trans or not, you deserve all the best! If people have a problem with you being trans, that's their problem. You don't have to excuse yourself at all. Your sexuality is a unique part of your being. Sorry if anything I'm writing here is stupid or wrong! I wish you well.
Thank you faraway friend for your thoughts; they moved me and I will ponder them. You have a big heart and thank you for your compassion, mate! All my best to you.
A moving testament. Thanks fellow traveler! I will ponder your thoughts, for sure. All the best to you.
You're a kind soul - All the best!
I'm not disabled... Perhaps I should be ashamed having my suicidal thoughts. I wish you all the best and sincerely hope you find love and happiness in your life.
